about: Records request drafts for the budget years BayCounty.me is missing (FY2015 onward). Seeded into corr.records_requests and sent only from /admin.

requests.government: Bay County Board of County Commissioners
requests.subject: Public records request: General Fund department budgets, FY2015-FY2025 and FY2027
requests.body:
Under Chapter 119, Florida Statutes, I’m requesting copies of the adopted budget’s General Fund appropriations by department (or division) for each of these fiscal years. The “Summary of All Funds” tables are already posted on the county website; what I’m missing is the department-level breakdown of the General Fund:

- FY2015 (Oct 1, 2014 to Sep 30, 2015)
- FY2016 (Oct 1, 2015 to Sep 30, 2016)
- FY2017 (Oct 1, 2016 to Sep 30, 2017)
- FY2018 (Oct 1, 2017 to Sep 30, 2018)
- FY2019 (Oct 1, 2018 to Sep 30, 2019)
- FY2020 (Oct 1, 2019 to Sep 30, 2020)
- FY2021 (Oct 1, 2020 to Sep 30, 2021)
- FY2022 (Oct 1, 2021 to Sep 30, 2022)
- FY2023 (Oct 1, 2022 to Sep 30, 2023)
- FY2024 (Oct 1, 2023 to Sep 30, 2024)
- FY2025 (Oct 1, 2024 to Sep 30, 2025)
- FY2027 (Oct 1, 2026 to Sep 30, 2027)

Electronic copies (PDF or spreadsheet) by email are preferred. If any of these are already posted online, a link is all I need. If a year can’t be found, please say so and I’ll take what exists.

This is a non-commercial request. These records will be used to show residents how the budget has changed over time on BayCounty.me, an independent public-records site for Bay County. If fulfilling it will cost more than $25, please send an estimate before starting.

Thank you,
Jeremy McSpadden
BayCounty.me
requests.notes: Optional: the county’s fund totals are complete for every year; this asks only for General Fund department detail.

requests.body:

The budget book, the budget ordinance or resolution with its exhibits, or the summary presented at the final September hearing would each work:
